_what: Every number and address tool:pull-in-a-creator (do-work/pull-in-a-creator.mjs) uses. `lists` says, per platform, how a creator's whole post list is asked for: `youtube.tabs` are the channel tabs listed with yt-dlp; `x` and `instagram` are treg catalog endpoints (`endpoint`, the body or query field the handle goes in, the cursor field sent back and the answer paths of items, next cursor and whether more exist). `pages_at_most` bounds one account's listing per run. `media.video_height_at_most` is the tallest picture downloaded for frames (frames need shapes and words on screen, not full quality). `frames.scene_change` is ffmpeg's scene score above which a frame is kept, `frames.at_most_per_video` caps them, `frames.width` scales them, and `frames.sheet_columns` lays one contact sheet per video. `words.whisper_model` is the mlx Whisper model used when a video has no captions of its own. `seconds_between_requests` is the polite wait between site requests.
